checks.check: Execution fails during import, file access or device initialization.
checks.how: Read the first traceback and inspect available files, installed packages and tensor devices.

checks.check: The loaded checkpoint disagrees with the model architecture or vocabulary.
checks.how: Compare saved configuration, weight keys and shapes, tokenizer vocabulary and missing or unexpected load keys.

checks.check: The selected checkpoint files are missing, ambiguous or different from the intended run.
checks.how: List artifact directories and compare resolved filenames and fold identifiers with the run manifest.

checks.check: Rows or feature columns can be reordered or mismatched across pipeline stages.
checks.how: Compare identifier uniqueness, merge cardinality, row order, feature names and column order at each boundary.

checks.check: Inference encodings or missing-value treatment differ from those used in training.
checks.how: Compare persisted encoders, category maps, required input fields and NaN counts before model input.

checks.check: The ensemble output cannot be reproduced from its intended component arrays and weights.
checks.how: Recompute a few rows by hand and inspect array types, shapes, normalization, fold loops and final output references.

checks.check: Evaluation callbacks fail or disagree with independently computed values.
checks.how: Inspect callback arguments and validation-set names, compare a small known example, and numerically check custom derivatives.

checks.check: The output file is missing, constant, stale or produced from the wrong input data.
checks.how: Read the generated file and verify IDs, columns, row count, variation and equality with the final prediction array.

checks.check: Several stages are unverified and the first faulty transformation is unknown.
checks.how: Run a tiny representative batch and inspect shapes, values and exceptions after each transformation.

checks.check: A code or artifact refactor was intended to preserve predictions but may have changed them.
checks.how: Run both versions on the same fixed sample and compare intermediate and final arrays with suitable numeric tolerance.

checks.check: Several independently adjustable factors changed together.
checks.how: Inspect version diffs and identify factors that can be toggled without changing other inputs.

checks.check: A recent modification caused a substantial regression relative to a reproducible saved baseline.
checks.how: Compare scores and output diagnostics against the saved configuration, checkpoint and feature artifacts.

checks.check: The preferred setting has reversed when another tightly coupled setting changed.
checks.how: Compare earlier paired trials and identify the interacting settings and their feasible combinations.

checks.check: Target imbalance or sparse target ranges leave random folds unrepresentative.
checks.how: Tabulate labels or continuous-target bins in each fold and check minimum stratum sizes.

checks.check: Rows share entities or topics whose information would cross an ordinary random split.
checks.how: Inspect entity overlap and topic or feature-cluster membership across proposed folds.

checks.check: A known training subgroup differs from the expected test population.
checks.how: Compare subgroup features and target frequencies, then assert no row overlaps between fit and validation.

checks.check: A large holdout materially reduces training data and its estimates no longer change model selection.
checks.how: Inspect learning curves and score uncertainty at different holdout sizes while retaining independent evaluation.

checks.check: Local validation and external evaluation rank the same candidate models differently.
checks.how: Collect paired candidate scores, split definitions and evaluation sizes and assess consistency across folds.

checks.check: The proposed split places the same row or entity in both training and validation.
checks.how: Intersect training and validation row identifiers and entity identifiers in each proposed fold.

checks.check: No valid end-to-end prediction and evaluation result exists yet.
checks.how: Check the run ledger for a reproducible prediction file, metric implementation and baseline score.

checks.check: Several edits changed together or a regression has no clear cause.
checks.how: Compare the configurations and artifacts used by the last good and current runs.

checks.check: Reported gains are small relative to suspected stochastic or evaluation-set variation.
checks.how: Inspect repeated predictions, random seeds, evaluation size and the distribution of unchanged-run scores.

checks.check: The existing validation split is absent, unstable or disagrees with the target evaluation.
checks.how: Compare fold label distributions, repeated entities and local-versus-held-out model rankings.

checks.check: One numeric parameter remains uncertain and reliable local scores can distinguish its settings.
checks.how: Inspect prior sweep values, validation scores and noise estimates to identify an untested bracket.

checks.check: Repeated nearby trials have failed to improve the best verified result.
checks.how: Review the trial ledger for marginal gains, regression frequency and unchanged-run variation.

checks.check: The unit of prediction and structure of repeated raw records are not yet understood.
checks.how: Inspect schema, entity counts, time ordering, missingness and representative grouped records.

checks.check: Several observations belong to one prediction entity and only a small summary is currently used.
checks.how: Inspect records per entity, ordering and existing aggregate columns.

checks.check: Order and recency contain variation that full-history summaries conceal.
checks.how: Plot ordered entity histories and compare last values, historical means and recent windows.

checks.check: Related columns or metadata imply a signal not expressed in the present features.
checks.how: Inspect domain definitions, joint feature distributions and residuals by the proposed interaction.

checks.check: Text structure or error patterns vary with the target beyond the current representation.
checks.how: Inspect labeled texts, residuals and existing length, spelling, sentence and readability features.

checks.check: Lexical frequency or local word patterns are absent or poorly covered by current features.
checks.how: Inspect vectorizer vocabulary, n-gram coverage, document frequencies and decomposition dimensions.

checks.check: Semantic embeddings are absent, or existing embedding sources have uncertain marginal value.
checks.how: Inspect source provenance and dimensions and review embedding-source ablations on held-out data.

checks.check: Another model or related labeled source provides predictive information absent from current inputs.
checks.how: Inspect auxiliary labels, fold provenance, identifier joins and whether every training prediction excludes its own label.

checks.check: Distinct text roles or observed metadata are lost by the current input encoding.
checks.how: Inspect tokenized examples, field boundaries and metadata availability at both training and inference.

checks.check: A cleaning or tokenization rule changes information relevant to the target or checkpoint.
checks.how: Compare raw and transformed examples, tokenizer outputs and the saved training preprocessing.

checks.check: Current numeric preprocessing may erase missingness or impose transformations the learner does not need.
checks.how: Inspect missing-value patterns, learner support, preprocessing artifacts and ablation scores.

checks.check: The inference image size differs from training or may discard task-relevant detail.
checks.how: Read checkpoint preprocessing metadata and inspect resized examples and previous resolution trials.

checks.check: Image input statistics differ from the checkpoint’s training preprocessing.
checks.how: Compare channel order and pixel statistics before and after preprocessing with the saved recipe.

checks.check: A meaningful fraction of task-relevant text is truncated.
checks.how: Measure token-length distribution and inspect the portions removed by current truncation.

checks.check: Many low-ranked features remain and their contribution is uncertain.
checks.how: Inspect fold-aggregated importance and compare validation scores for smaller and larger retained sets.

checks.check: A specific feature family is redundant, noisy or previously harmful.
checks.how: Review group-level ablations, missingness, cardinality and correlations with existing features.

checks.check: Available importance methods disagree about which features to retain.
checks.how: Compare fold-stable rankings and validation scores of equally sized selected subsets.

checks.check: A saved feature list was built for a different feature schema.
checks.how: Compare selected column names and artifact metadata with the current engineered columns.

checks.check: A known subset has unreliable labels or differs from the intended test population.
checks.how: Inspect out-of-fold residuals, label audits and subgroup feature/label distributions.

checks.check: Rare classes or target-like subgroups have insufficient influence on fitting.
checks.how: Tabulate class and subgroup frequencies and inspect metric contributions and current sampling weights.

checks.check: A sparse subgroup has too few examples and plausible interpolation neighbors exist.
checks.how: Inspect subgroup sample sizes and neighbor distances, and verify augmentation excludes validation rows.

checks.check: Training images exhibit nuisance variation that valid augmentation could reproduce.
checks.how: Inspect augmented examples, domain label invariances and train-versus-validation learning curves.

checks.check: Raw data contains structure not represented by current features.
checks.how: Compare source records with the feature schema and model input examples.

checks.check: The feature set is large, changed recently or contains suspected unhelpful groups.
checks.how: Inspect feature counts, importance stability, ablation scores and saved selection provenance.

checks.check: Label quality, imbalance or limited coverage constrains the current learner.
checks.how: Inspect residuals, label frequencies and subgroup distributions.

checks.check: Available backbones differ in capacity or domain pretraining relevant to the task.
checks.how: Inspect pretrained model provenance, capacity, memory needs and controlled standalone scores.

checks.check: The tuned current tree method has plateaued and another boosting implementation is available.
checks.how: Review baseline curves and each candidate’s objective, missing-value and early-stopping support.

checks.check: A minimal or poorly matched prediction head limits an otherwise useful representation.
checks.how: Inspect the head, pooling and target structure together with head ablations and checkpoint compatibility.

checks.check: The present output activation or label formulation mismatches the target structure.
checks.how: Inspect target support, independence, ordering, metric penalties and the current loss/activation pair.

checks.check: A generative model could score the text but its output reliability is unverified.
checks.how: Inspect generated scores on labeled held-out examples for format validity, range and target agreement.

checks.check: Outcomes contain censoring or the metric evaluates risk ranking within known subgroups.
checks.how: Inspect event indicators, observed durations, censoring rates and per-group metric definitions.

checks.check: Target centering differs across folds or from the inference output scale.
checks.how: Inspect fold target means, transform fitting scope and inverse-transform code.

checks.check: The current loss optimizes a surrogate that poorly tracks the held-out metric.
checks.how: Compare loss and metric trajectories and inspect candidate gradients, Hessians and target semantics.

checks.check: The best epoch or iteration under the current stopping metric is not best under the target metric.
checks.how: Recompute both metrics over saved validation predictions along the training trajectory.

checks.check: The current API obscures required probability output or evaluation controls.
checks.how: Inspect method signatures, prediction semantics and callback support on a minimal fit.

checks.check: Training fit or the train-validation gap suggests an inappropriate tree capacity.
checks.how: Compare curves and past depth/leaf sweeps with feature count and sample size.

checks.check: The fitted model overfits or current regularization suppresses useful signal.
checks.how: Inspect learning curves and controlled penalty, subsampling or dropout sweeps.

checks.check: Training is unstable or stops before a lower-rate run can converge.
checks.how: Inspect per-iteration curves, learning rates, stopping points and maximum iteration caps.

checks.check: Validation improvement continues at the cap or has already reversed before the selected checkpoint.
checks.how: Plot validation performance against epochs or rounds and inspect best-iteration and patience logs.

checks.check: Convergence behavior suggests the current optimization schedule is a bottleneck.
checks.how: Inspect learning-rate history, loss oscillation and comparable optimizer runs.

checks.check: An ensemble member lacks reproducible fold-trained models or unbiased validation predictions.
checks.how: Inspect training splits, per-fold checkpoint saves and OOF coverage with no self-prediction.

checks.check: Compatible snapshots occupy nearby useful solutions and individual predictions vary.
checks.how: Check identical parameter schemas and snapshot validation behavior along the training trajectory.

checks.check: The existing formulation has plateaued and a materially different candidate is available.
checks.how: Review same-input comparisons and candidate architecture or training metadata.

checks.check: The current training signal differs from what evaluation rewards.
checks.how: Read target construction, loss and evaluation implementations and compare their validation behavior.

checks.check: Learning curves show that current fitting settings are inadequate.
checks.how: Inspect loss, validation metric, selected iterations and training resource logs.

checks.check: The ensemble’s errors are shared across similar members and a distinct candidate is available.
checks.how: Compare aligned OOF residual correlations and held-out gains from small-weight candidate inclusion.

checks.check: Existing models share an architecture but alternative training or feature recipes yield different errors.
checks.how: Inspect recipe provenance and residual correlation of predictions from the alternative variants.

checks.check: Some available members may add noise or redundancy despite acceptable standalone scores.
checks.how: Compute single-member and leave-one-member-out metrics on aligned held-out predictions.

checks.check: Removing or disabling previously validated members caused a regression.
checks.how: Compare the current member manifest and outputs with the last verified ensemble.

checks.check: Several compatible trained checkpoints differ in seed, recipe or training stage.
checks.how: Inspect artifact metadata and evaluate each through identical preprocessing and aggregation.

checks.check: Fold quality or training-regime mismatch may make some available checkpoints harmful.
checks.how: Inspect per-fold scores, training provenance and independent inclusion/exclusion results.

checks.check: A candidate improves standalone score but adds no gain in prior fixed-weight inclusion tests.
checks.how: Compare candidate standalone and incremental ensemble scores on the same disjoint evaluation rows.

checks.check: Useful fold-trained checkpoints are omitted or too few folds limit training coverage.
checks.how: Inspect checkpoint coverage, per-fold prediction differences and incremental averaging scores.

checks.check: Predictions vary across trained seeds beyond the expected evaluation noise.
checks.how: Compare aligned predictions and scores from seed-specific checkpoints and incremental averages.

checks.check: The task is invariant to candidate transformations and predictions vary across those views.
checks.how: Inspect transformed examples, domain invariances and paired held-out predictions with and without TTA.

checks.check: Dropout is active or intentionally proposed at inference and creates nontrivial prediction variance.
checks.how: Check model train/eval flags and compare repeated forward passes on identical inputs.

checks.check: Several stopping-rule or training-stage snapshots have complementary errors.
checks.how: Inspect checkpoint provenance and held-out predictions from best and final training snapshots.

checks.check: Members have similar quality or optimized combinations have unstable held-out gains.
checks.how: Compare member scores and equal versus tuned combination performance across held-out folds.

checks.check: Members differ in useful contribution and held-out predictions support weight comparisons.
checks.how: Evaluate a coarse weight grid, residual correlation and stability of the best region across folds.

checks.check: A candidate is anti-correlated with residual error after accounting for stronger members.
checks.how: Fit or evaluate bounded signed weights on OOF predictions and confirm improvement on separate folds.

checks.check: Member scales differ or raw versus rank aggregation has changed preference across configurations.
checks.how: Plot member score distributions and compare both aggregation methods on identical held-out predictions.

checks.check: Member scales or outliers distort their intended relative contributions.
checks.how: Inspect per-member quantiles and outliers; fit candidate scalers on OOF data and apply them unchanged.

checks.check: Families have unequal numbers of checkpoints that would otherwise determine their influence.
checks.how: Count members per family and inspect the effective weights under flat versus grouped averaging.

checks.check: Enough OOF examples exist to learn stable complementary relationships among base outputs.
checks.how: Audit OOF provenance, meta-feature count, held-out stacker gains and regularization sensitivity.

checks.check: The available meta-features contain in-sample predictions or have unverifiable fold provenance.
checks.how: Trace every training meta-feature to a base-model fold and assert that its row was excluded during fitting.

checks.check: The current set may omit complementary signal or include harmful members.
checks.how: Review candidate residual correlations and fixed-blend inclusion ablations.

checks.check: A single predictor is unstable and repeatable alternatives are available.
checks.how: Inspect variability across folds, seeds and valid input transformations.

checks.check: Valid model outputs differ in quality, scale or complementary error.
checks.how: Inspect member prediction distributions, residual correlations and available OOF sample size.

checks.check: The metric depends on order and proposed transformations only erase or perturb useful ordering.
checks.how: Inspect metric semantics and compare raw outputs with transformed ranks and held-out scores.

checks.check: Labels occupy known ordered levels and learned thresholds are not reliably better.
checks.how: Inspect allowed labels and compare fixed versus fitted thresholds on independent held-out predictions.

checks.check: Continuous outputs carry signal but fixed cutpoints systematically misallocate ordinal labels.
checks.how: Inspect OOF score distributions by label and independent gains from ordered threshold optimization.

checks.check: Target-level frequencies are stable enough that a reference distribution may improve mapping.
checks.how: Compare training and representative validation label frequencies and hold out samples for evaluating the map.

checks.check: Residual distributions differ reproducibly across groups available at inference.
checks.how: Plot groupwise residuals, counts and independently scored global versus group-specific mappings.

checks.check: Previously optimized cutpoints fail to improve a separate held-out set.
checks.how: Apply saved cutpoints unchanged to an independent labeled split and compare with fixed rounding.

checks.check: The target has a restricted range or a small ordered set of values.
checks.how: Inspect label frequencies and the metric’s response to ties and discretization.

checks.check: Predictions have an inverted convention or a reproducible additive bias.
checks.how: Inspect target/output conventions and plot held-out residual means, including a fixed reference when available.

checks.check: Prediction ranges mismatch the required support or the calibration distribution.
checks.how: Compare output quantiles with allowed values and training/OOF prediction distributions.

checks.check: Component confidence distributions are mismatched and their nonlinear combination changes ordering.
checks.how: Plot calibration and quantiles of component probabilities and compare transformed blends on held-out rows.

checks.check: An auxiliary classifier or observable rule predicts a specific systematic residual.
checks.how: Measure the rule’s held-out precision and residual effect, checking output columns and correction masks.

checks.check: Post-processing was tuned before an upstream change or its contribution is unknown.
checks.how: Compare transformed and raw versions of identical stored predictions on the same held-out rows.

checks.check: Full runs are too expensive to locate errors or screen candidate settings.
checks.how: Measure stage runtimes and inspect debug flags, fold coverage and restored production settings.

checks.check: The full dataset or feature matrix exceeds available memory.
checks.how: Measure peak table size and group sizes, then verify complete-entity chunking and output coverage.

checks.check: Peak memory rises across successive model or feature stages.
checks.how: Profile live objects and device memory, and trace downstream references before releasing objects.

checks.check: Inference fails at large batches or padding dominates sequence computation.
checks.how: Inspect batch peak memory and sequence lengths and compare identifier-aligned outputs after rebatching.

checks.check: Model inference dominates memory and supported lower precision may reduce its footprint.
checks.how: Compare full and reduced-precision predictions and held-out metrics on a representative batch.

checks.check: Most run time recomputes artifacts unchanged by the current experiment.
checks.how: Profile stages and compare feature/model configuration hashes with saved artifact metadata.

checks.check: Multiple variants share fragile duplicated code or overwrite each other’s artifacts.
checks.how: Trace configuration dispatch, per-model preprocessing, filenames and stage dependencies.

checks.check: The required fold training cannot finish within one session but completed checkpoints can be persisted.
checks.how: Compare per-fold runtime with session limits and inspect a manifest of successfully saved folds.

checks.check: Repeated metric computation dominates search time rather than model fitting.
checks.how: Profile evaluation calls and compare the optimized and reference metric on fixed arrays including edge cases.

checks.check: The current run fails or its predictions violate an expected invariant.
checks.how: Inspect errors, output shapes, row identifiers, prediction ranges and a known-good run.

checks.check: A score change cannot yet be attributed to a reproducible intervention.
checks.how: Inspect experiment diffs, repeated-run scores and validation-versus-held-out rankings.

checks.check: The current inputs discard useful structure or contain demonstrated noise.
checks.how: Inspect raw examples, feature provenance, ablation results and train/test distributions.

checks.check: Valid inputs and evaluation still expose underfitting, overfitting or objective mismatch.
checks.how: Inspect learning curves, residuals, model capacity and target/metric definitions.

checks.check: Several valid predictors are available or a predictor has measurable variance.
checks.how: Inspect aligned held-out predictions, individual scores and residual correlations.

checks.check: Valid raw predictions violate target structure or show a correctable held-out bias.
checks.how: Compare raw outputs with target distributions, subgroup residuals and submission requirements.

checks.check: Runtime, memory or repeated computation prevents completing informative experiments.
checks.how: Inspect stage timings, peak memory, run logs and existing cached artifacts.
